name: Pili Squad — Backend PHP (Symfony / API Platform / 2cloud)
description: Backend engineering standards for the Pili squad across 2cloud-services microservices (PHP 8.3+, Symfony, API Platform, Doctrine) and 2cloud (CakePHP).
agentInstructions: Enforce strict PHP 8.3+ typing, readonly classes, API Platform Resource vs DTO separation with AutoMapper, multi-tenant security & voter isolation (404 anti-enumeration), LegacyId-to-Uuid conversion (ban getCustomUuid()), and right-sized declarative PHPUnit/Behat testing without property-by-property mutation or redundant test bloat.
